displayAddress: The Arthouse, George Street, Manchester, M1 4AB
description:
Julie Twist Properties welcomes to the market this studio apartment located within the beautifully converted Arthouse in the heart of the City Centre. The property is set on the second floor and offers a an open-plan kitchen and living area which also has built-in wardrobe space and a built-in pull-down double bed. Accessed via the hallway is a three-piece bathroom suite, a storage cupboard housing the hot water tank and stairs leading up to the deck area which is perfect for extra storage space. Original features have been retained throughout, including exposed brick walls, large sash windows and wooden beams.

The Arthouse is a stone's throw from St Peter's Square Metrolink stop, offering easy access around and out of the City Centre. Piccadilly Gardens, Market Street and the Arndale Centre are all within a short walk and there is an abundance of cafes, shops and restaurants nearby for you to enjoy.
